title: Tileable texture: a Flow that generates a texture that repeats by construction (games, 3D materials)
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 - The Flow track. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-18 (Fabio, board tidy).

Split from MPI-1101 (Fabio, 2026-10-13). Make seamless only repaints a band along each edge, so a big shape crossing an edge (marble vein) or uneven light still repeats when tiled. This Flow is the other job: describe a texture (or give a picture as a style reference) and get back a NEW flat, evenly lit texture that tiles everywhere. Research first: does wrap-around sampling (rolling the latent every step, circular VAE) give a true tile on Klein 9B or Krea 2? Circular conv padding works on SD/SDXL UNets only (spinagon/ComfyUI-seamless-tiling, see MPI-1101 research/brainstorm.md). Bench on the local GPU needs Fabio's go. Even out lighting belongs here. Not required to ship with Make seamless: its description now says it does not make game textures.
